historical_decision.result: balanced accuracy, 4.0 micrometre per pixel minus 0.5 micrometre per pixel: -0.633. No contrast interval reported. The general vision-language baseline barely moved from its low starting level (-0.033), and the information-availability baseline held 0.667 where CONCH reached 0.138, so class information survived the transformation. The DINOv2 probe's own decline of 0.302 was retained as a real effect shared across models
